title: Quaint Fluffy Norwegian Lamb Casserole
description: A traditional Norwegian dish featuring lamb, potatoes, and a hint of yellow food coloring, made with infuse-oil for a unique flavor. This recipe is onion and garlic free, making it accessible to those with sensitivities.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the infuse-oil over medium heat and cook the lamb until browned, about 5 minutes.
In a separate pot, boil the sliced potatoes until they are slightly tender, about 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked lamb, potatoes, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the heavy cream and yellow food coloring.
Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with the butter.
Add the lamb and potato mixture to the baking dish and pour the cream mixture over the top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
